title: ViewPoint MCP session (VP_MCP_SESSION)
description: Single JSON session file for vp_mcp.py. Every path must be absolute. Startup refuses on any missing/relative/unsafe path.

env_launcher.description: Absolute path to the generated env.sh that runs a command in the app's clean env.

srf_bin.description: Absolute path to srf-identity-surface. Only the read-only ax verb is used.

state_dir.description: Absolute path to the app's MV_SRF_STATE_DIR (private control state directory).

xdg_state.description: Absolute /dev/shm private evidence base used as XDG_STATE_HOME. Also holds the browser-task lock file.

attach_env.description: Absolute path to the live attachment current.env (the METAVIEWER_ATTACH value). Must export MV_CORE_CONFIG and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR.
